name: Westfield Promenade
description: Westfield Promenade is a premier outdoor shopping destination in the heart of Woodland Hills, offering a curated mix of popular retailers, diverse dining options, and entertainment venues. This open-air center features iconic brands like Apple, H&M, Uniqlo, and Decathlon, creating a vibrant shopping experience in the San Fernando Valley. With convenient amenities including Smart Parking and click-and-collect services, Westfield Promenade combines retail excellence with modern convenience in a beautifully designed setting.
